_doc: Pi-IR projection of empty_signed_thinking_drop/messages_sse.json. ASYMMETRIC harness divergence where XLI SUBSETS pi: pi at index.ts:1107 emits a thinking block with the (possibly empty) content + thinkingSignature on output.content[]. XLI deliberately DROPS the block because Anthropic's signature verifier rejects replay of a signature computed over content the proxy never returned (S-OPUS47-EMPTY-THINKING, sse/messages.rs:614-620). Closes RI-019 (BLOCKS_PROD — Empty signed thinking drop). The pi_state_machine still exercises the thinking branches; the divergence is at the stop emission policy. The XLI emission is a strict subset, so the fixture uses _xli_full_sequence rather than assert_pi_projection_equivalent (which would expect XLI to emit the Reasoning).
